entries.text: "Hmph! Not yet! I won't fall yet!!"
"Hmph... To survive this\nlong, With skill like that..."
"Do your best, Xabungle!\nAnd don't drink all my gas!"
"Gasoline gives this much\npower too! With a Garia!"
"Heh, always wanted to say that. Heh"
"Try and win! Walker Gallia's a man!"
"It'd be a waste not to do it here!"
"Can't let Blume have all the glory!"
"Maria's really fired\nup! I can't fall behind!"
"As a man, I can't just look away!"
"Even a minor character has to be here!"
"Treat women right, dad always said so!"
"When it's time, a man shows it!"
"My moves are faster than a train!"
"This kind of cold is nothing to me!"
"Ugh! My arms and legs are creaking!"
"No matter how hard\nyou try, no lead role!"
"I can't lose here - I'm the star!"
"I won't die like a dog here!"
"S-strong...! At this rate I must\ntighten my belt and get serious!"
"Whoa! Is Sibe Rail\nreally going all out?!"
"I lack the power for a comeback!"
"Damn it! Too much\nfaith in the new power!"
"Son of Iron Arm won't\ndie in a place like this!"
"Timp, you... I won't go down so easy!"
"Hola!\nYou really did it this time, damn it!"
"Jiron, goodbye. I was\nlucky to have known you!"
"Jiron, we can't take much more! Hurry!"
"Are you okay, Jiron?! Read\na maiden's anxious heart!"
"What are you doing! All\nthat posing got you hit!"
"Not done yet! The fight\nis on--full throttle!"
"Ha ha ha! The lead fall so easily?"
"You remember this, Timp!\nI will never give up!"
"I thought you were just a poser...\nNot bad, Hola!"
"See? I told you to watch out!"
"Ha ha ha! The invincible\nXabungle. Scared yet?"
"Ha ha ha! The Garia's invincible too!"
"Damn, I hit the brake by mistake!"
"What's wrong, Hola! That all you got!"
"Jiron, what's wrong? You\nokay? This is nothing..."
"I won't be swiss cheese that easily!"
"Whoa! Idiot, stop! What if you hit me!"
"The attack is a pattern, isn't it"
"Oh? For a mobile suit,\nthat's all it's got"
"Shooting from the sky, Won't hit me!"
"Timp! I won't be hit by your bullets!"
"Heh, like I'd be hit\nby some wimpy bullets!"
"Nice! Keep it up, keep it up!"
"I can't watch this! Let me drive!"
"Not yet! I can still\ngo! I guarantee it!"
"Even against a Walker\nMachine, it's all about skill!"
"Stop this and go find a\nnew love, why don't you!"
"No gags! For the\nfinale, we go serious!"
"The final act belongs\nto me, Jiron Amos!"
"The Edel! This is where you end!"
"What Sibe Rail is doing is no\ndifferent from the Innocent!"
"I won't lose to a round face!"
"Timp! So we meet After all this time!"
"You've got droopy eyes,\nyet act like a rival!"
"You never let up, Hola! Even when you're\nmad, you've still got droopy eyes!"
"Came from the moon, but\nwe're all human... So win!"
"Damn it! Which one's The real one!?"
"I won't let aliens run\nwild as they please!"
"Alien scum! I'll blast you to stars!"
"Don't think flying gives you an edge!"
"Out of the way! Even you\nhave lines you can't cross!"
"Whoa! If I die, you come too!"
"Fly to the ends of the earth!!"
"If I have to fight, I'll fight!"
"If I don't do it, who will!"
"I've got the power to protect them!"
"Won't let you mess with Destiny Plan!"
"Why!? Why won't you\nListen to the chairman!"
"To save the world, I'll fight anyone!"
"You're in the way of\na world without war!"
"I won't let you go any further!"
"With this, I can take on anyone!"
"With Destiny, I can fight like this!"
"I will do it... I have to do it!"
"Can do nothing, no point being here!"
"You can't keep up with the Destiny!"
"Do you want war that\nbadly? Is that it!"
"What is he...? What's\nhe trying to do...?"
"Again! That guy is\naiming for the cockpit!"
"Get serious! Or you'll\nget the same result!"
"Do you know what you're doing! Stella!"
"Go all out! Like when I fought Stella!"
"I can still do it! Save Stella!"
"As long as the Core Splendor\nis unharmed, I can still fight!"
"Damn it! Not to someone\nI can't even understand!!"
"You mean if you were serious,\nI'd be dead already?!"
"Using that machine so well!\nWho the hell are you?!"
"To go this far in a stolen machine...!"
"I'll protect you! I'll protect\nyou!! So please, no more!!"
"Stop it, Stella! Don't you get me!?"
"You want to stir up the\nbattlefield so much?!"
"You know nothing! You don't\nget the chairman's plan!"
"Damn it! Why you of all people!"
"You! What are you trying to do?!"
"With that much power, why\ncouldn't you protect Orb then!?"
"You don't understand anything!\nYou're nothing but a traitor!!"
"Head to base and drop off Meyrin!"
"PLANT and Earth... Using\nboth for your ambition!"
"Come at us, and Orb's your enemy!"
"I beat him once! I can do it again!"
"We all fought with\nour lives... And you!"
"The Edel! We are not your tools!"
"We will defeat you and end this war!"
"Are you all so great!? You Titans!"
"Durandal Chairman! I won't\nmove how you want anymore!"
"I'll create a world\nwithout war in my own way!"
"Pretty words only! I'm sick of it!"
"Loran! Are you trying\nto wipe out the world?!"
"To protect the future,\nI'll fight you all!!"
"Don't forget! You're the\nones who attacked first!"
"If you're an Anomaly,\nhelp fix the world!"
"You too... all of you! Damn it all!!"
"You killed Stella! I tried to stop it!"
"I came to annihilate you, you know!"
"It's real, so make it\nmore fun than a game!"
"Ah ha, I won! I beat the game champ!"
"Dodge this combo and you score big!"
"No good, no good! Guard a little!"
"Gainer, against a real Overman,\nI'm the better one, you know"
"Too bad. There are no\ncontinues in this game"
"With the right sense, using\nit is no trouble at all!"
"That's right! Playing open\nfeels great and scores big!"
"Let's make a game, Gainer!\nWhoever drops it wins!"
"Do I have to babysit\nsome outsider too?"
"If you space out, you'll get hit!"
"I won't let us game over here!"
"Feints are just a game to me!"
"All you have to do is follow me!"
"I won't let some creep touch me!"
"If you're not serious,\nyou can't beat me!"
"Get it together! Playing around\nis no fun unless it's for real!"
"Is that all? Then I'll mock you!"
"Make it more exciting! Or\nthere's no point fighting!"
"Oh? I didn't think a rat could hit me."
"The stronger the foe, the more I burn!"
"Heh... so this is what battle is...!"
"Way to go Gainer! I love it!"
"I'm so happy! Guess\nwe really are rivals!"
"Not yet! I'll Exodus\nwith Gainer and them!"
"Grr... nice one, Game\nChamp...! That's what I want!"
"You small-town fools\nthink you can match me?"
"Can't you fight without\na trio or a pair?"
"The Edel! I won't let\nyou be the game master!"
"Gainer...? Fun, isn't\nit? Heh heh heh heh..."
"Let's play, Gainer... A\nnew game is starting..."
"Ooh, scary. Adults really do\ncome at you to kill."
"You think a mere Overman\ncan really take me down?"
"It's useless, machine angel.\nSoon all will be painted black"
"Smart ones like you know\nwhat Overdevil plans, right?"
"Oh, I see. You wanna fight back?"
"It's your fault. You attacked us first"
"After all, Gainer is\nthe only one who cares!"
"If you joke, go home.\nDon't show your face"
"So you're really set on blocking me"
"You noisy pests...! You\nreally want me dead...!?"
"Resist hard and die a\nworthy enemy of mine!"
"Come out and I'll hit you with 100%!"
"Give me that machine!\nFight with the same!"
"Whoa!? This was not part of the drill!"
"Damn Gundam... How dare you do this!!"
"Ugh! Is this the gap in pilot skill?"
"I won't stay beaten!\nMy DNA won't allow it!"
"This Mahiroo won't lose\nto a machine like that!"
"Earth's army is weak.\nNo fight means no bite!"
"Don't tell me you think\nthat puts you on my level?"
"The White Mustache's name\nmakes my DNA boil!"
"Stay down and crawl on the ground!"
"Come on, fight me fair and square!"
"I was waiting for an\nenemy like you, Gundam!"
"If you're in a Gundam, satisfy my DNA!"
"Kill or be killed...\nit's one of the two!"
"You think that's the end?! Too naive!"
"Hey hey! Are you even ZAFT's ace!?"
"Gonna beat me with that? New type!"
"Is this all that Gundam really is?"
"Damn it! A Gundam beaten by a Gundam?!"
"Guh, that pilot! I won't let it slide!"
"Even odds? Then I'll\nshow you real skill!"
"Tch! This type of mech's\npopular anywhere you go!"
"Hey hey! How much is ZAFT's new gear?!"
"Haha! This is the end for you!"
"There's no way I'd lose! Not me!!"
"What!? What kind of pilot is he!?"
"Don't mess with me!\nDon't mess with me!!"
"I have to beat them...\nEverything scary... all of it!"
"Let me show you the Glory Star way!"
"I'll be a warrior... For my mission!"
"I carry what I learned\nfrom Chief and Toby!"
"The Chief taught me\nhow to read the path!"
"To stop the Fed, we must fight!"
"I can't let the Federation run wild!"
"To think it would come\nto fighting you all..."
"I have no choice...!\nThey're the enemy now!"
"If I lose in power,\nI'll win with speed!"
"The war ends now! No\nBlack History repeat!"
"The world can't be left to one\nwho can't grasp people's sorrow!"
"Humanity needs a leader! Not a ruler!"
"One person has no right\nto decide the future!"
"If this sorrow gives\npower, I'll hurl it at you!"
"Captain Lowen...! That\nyou could be such a man!"
"I won't forget your kindness...\nEven if it was a lie...!"
"Those aren't the Chief\nor Toby I know...!"
"I... I fight for our Glory Star...!"
"The world is not yours alone!\nIt belongs to everyone!"
"The world doesn't need\na dictator like you!"
"I'm no hero of justice!\nI'm your enemy!"
"The Edel! I won't accept\nyour world, not ever!"
"This world is no playground!\nEveryone lives here!"
"Won't lose! Not to sorrow or fate!"
"My win is Glory Star's...\nso it must be..."
"Hold on a little longer... my body..."
"One heart of Chief, Toby, and me!"
"I will not hand this world to you!!"
"Chief and Toby's regret,\ninto this one blow!!"
"I'll cover you from\nhere! Go and do it!"
"From here, even the Ganary Carver\ncan't counter...!"
"Thanks to the motion data\nthe chief left behind..."
"Asakim...! I won't\nlet you have your way!"
"I won't fall to your games, Ziene!"
"If I hit you, it will please you...!"
"He's not the chief... Not the chief..."
"Neither the world nor\nI will go as you wish!"
"The Edel Bernal! I can still fight!"
"If I flinch from\ndamage, I can't fight!"
"If I get hit by this, I\ncan't face the chiefs...!"
"So you mean to torment\nme little by little...!?"
"A vicious attack...! One\nhit and it's over...!"
"Virgola is our pride...!\nYou won't get past us!"
"If he reads my path, I'll\njust change my moves...!"
"I won't scream...! I'm a fighter too!"
"In dire times, I recall\nall I've learned...!"
"Glory Star is the star\nof glory! It won't fall!"
"That man is laughing\nat me...! I won't lose!"
"Asakim is still playing...!\nI can't afford to waver!"
"If I admit defeat, I'll\nonly please him...!"
"Is that all, Ziene?!\nYou make me laugh!"
"Do you hate women that\nmuch, Captain Lowen!?"
"My mission is to\nsurvive! I won't die!!"
"Not on my watch! I'll protect\nVirgola with my pride!"
"I'll never give up...!\nThat's what Toby taught me!"
"I won't lose! Not to\nhim, Asakim, or grief!"
"Captain Lowen's malice\nis closing in on me...!?"
"I'm also a Glory Star! I'll\nshow you what I've got!"
"Train right and I can do it...!"
"I'm a member of the Glory Star too!"
"This is war! I am a soldier!"
"Read moves as a line, not a point!"
"If no direct hit, hold them back!"
"Fooled by odd moves, and we're done!"
"That enemy... just watching it\nfeels like my soul is drawn in...!"
"If they overpower me, I have\nno chance of winning...!"
"I'll have to throw them\noff with pure speed...!"
"No matter the foe, I\nmust not falter...!"
"If we don't stop them, folks die!"
"For Chief and Toby...!\nI'll take them down!"
"So those are the AEUG...! The\nanti-Earth Federation force...!"
"I'm a soldier...! If ordered, I fight!"
"Even in this situation,\nthey force their own logic!"
"A machine built for construction\nwork... and it's carrying weapons?!"
"I have to master the Gunary Carver...!"
"Gathering data on this\nweapon is my duty...!"
"If I didn't strike, I'd be down!"
"The data Toby left behind,\nI won't waste it...!"
"I'll master the data the\nChief left behind...!"
"I gave my all, and did it..."
"Watch their moves, I can do it!"
"At this rate, I'll only\ndrag everyone down...!"
"N-no good! Can't keep up with them!"
"What do I do...!? What do I do!?"
"Calm down, me...! I was\ntaught to stay calm now!"
"Damage red zone! Is it over already!?"
"No...! I don't want to die yet!"
"I can't leave it all to Loran!"
"I'll cover the lack of firepower\nwith guts! ...Just like Gavane"
"They're no match for\nme! I can do this too!"
"I told you not to be reckless!"
"Kill me if you want! I am not\nafraid, I will join Father!"
"End like this? No way, I refuse!"
"T-to be this beaten... Gotta fix this!"
"Th-this much, I can cover with guts!"
"Ow! Meshe, where did you\ngo!? Give me backup here!"
"Oh, is that all? This\nis no problem at all!"
"Move just like I want you to!"
"I can't keep relying on Loran forever!"
"Think you can get me? Not a chance!"
"I won't be taken down by the Moonrace!"
"Your moves are old news to me!"
"I can pilot the White\nDoll myself, you know!"
"I don't need orders - I'll\navenge Father in the White Doll!"
"Leaving the White Doll to Loran\nis a waste of its potential!"
"Like I'd lose to a tacky machine doll!"
"Hop around all you\nwant! Now hold still!"
"With that around, everyone\nsuffers! That is why!"
"We need the hero mech by now!"
"Sand Rat's chance to shine.\nI'll do my part as backup!"
"This is it! ...Use me again next time!"
"S-strong! But this is where I hold!"
"Hang in there! You can do it!"
"Dike, are we really right for this?"
"Not on my watch!\n...How cheesy, heh heh"
"Don't judge me by my side role!"
"Damn! Out of gas?\nWhere's the spare tank?!"
"That's going too far, don't you think?"
"That's no good! I have to do better!"
"You could be a little\ngentler, you know!"
"Geez! No need to be so rough..."
"At this rate, I'll be done for!"
"I'll take you on in big bro's place!"
"All deserve to know their own future"
"Fire missiles the moment prep is done!"
"Primary weapon bank contact!\nOutput nominal! Safety off!"
"Tannhauser launch! Switch to\nfiring axis! Target front squad!"
"I won't let this ship\nsit idle! Cover me!"
"Ray unit, fall back. That is an order."
"Rapid turn! Break out of enemy range!"
"Turn back, hurry! Stop\nand you're a target!"
"So they've focused their attacks\non the Minerva, as expected."
"If that unit downed us,\nit'd be a bad comedy"
"As expected, survivor.\nIt was a close call"
"Don't think you can sink me so easy!"
"Hull sealed, armor light damage.\nNo real damage to report!"
"Outer armor damaged! But\ncombat capability is fine!"
"Don't panic, Arthur. Minerva\nwon't fall from this."
"It'll take more than this to stop me."
"No need. Then why come to the front?"
"Raid squad means a mothership\nnearby! Search hard!"
"Dragging this is pain!\nFinish in one blow!"
"No problem for operations!\nAll, focus on your tasks!"
"Keep moving forward! Arthur,\nI leave damage control to you!"
"Input enemy data! Keep\nwatch from now on!"
"Understood! This ship will\nnow shift to condition yellow!"
"Arthur! This is no\ntime to be impressed!"
"Thrust first! If need be,\nwe leave the battlefield!"
"This ship is ZAFT's symbol!\nI won't let it sink!"
"Max out the active\nthrusters! Hurry it up!"
"Captain, that blast hit\nthe engines and sensors!"
"FCS rebooting! Damage\ncontrol, I'm counting on you!"
"Seal off damaged blocks!\nGet the wounded below!"
"Meyrin! An operator\nshould not be yelling out!"
"We are at a disadvantage!\nBut I will hold the line!"
"Being here, I am ready\nfor that much already."
"No need! I have a duty\nhere to command the front!"
"Gh! To take this much damage\nfrom a stolen machine...!"
"As expected of Archangel! She does it!"
"Lacus Clyne, Kira\nYamato... Will you stop me?"
"As I said, this is a defense\nfor humanity's survival..."
"That power breeds war...\nWhy can't you see?"
"Beat me and the war won't end."
"Yes, I'm here... Come\nstop me if you can."
"My plan or that power... Which leads?"
"I won't end the world I show...!"
"You, with no vision,\ncannot guide the world...!"
"Do you even realize\nwhat it is you're doing?"
"Even if you stop me, you\ncannot guide this world."
"Let's see what the Archangel can do!"
"No time to think it\nover! Attacking now!"
"I know! Capture it, no matter what!"
"So you do stand in my way after all..."
"We can't let that ship escape!\nWe'll take it down here!"
"If only she had stayed PLANT's diva..."
"If you get in my way\nof the Destiny Plan..."
"I can't afford to stand still.\nFor this world's sake as well."
"No mercy needed! They are space scum!"
"Give them a scare! Let them\nknow our full strength!"
"Show Supreme Commander Gagarn\nwhat we can do!"
"Like moths to a flame!\nHarpies, scatter them!"
"Launch the Harpy unit!\nSweep them all away!"
"Teral, how dare you!\nKill him, kill him now!"
"Hit the ship! Destroy their way home!"
"Their energy is dangerous\ntoo! Destroy the units!"
"Earthlings! How much danger\ndo you hold in your energy!"
"Don't miss this chance!\nPlay it right, we score!"
"Supreme Commander Gagarn,\ngive me one more chance!"
"Tch! Me, having to be a shield!"
"Close in! At this range we're useless!"
"Is this all God Sigma amounts to?"
"Is that all? I see how this ends!"
"Trinity Energy's too much\nfor Earthlings to handle!"
"What are you doing?! I\nordered you to evade!"
"Move it, helmsman! Escape is that way!"
"We can't accept defeat! Fight or die!"
"Guh! If only we had Trinity Energy...!"
"Please...! Spare my life, I beg you!"
"Your fault for being in our way!"
"Power charge start! Heat\nrate rising in limits!"
"Enemy units are still in my range!"
"I'll make sure you can't chase us!"
"We know each other's moves.\nA slip means death...!"
"That's the spirit, Ken-Goh!\nBeat them to a pulp!"
"Then we can't just leave it alone!"
"This sad age ends... by our own hands!"
"I'll drag out the truth\nthe military's hiding!"
"Before you follow orders,\nThink about what you do!"
"Dewey! I won't let you stop Holland!"
"They're serious too! I\ncan't afford to hold back!"
"This is war! No way I'd spare you!"
"Mobility's on our side! I'll sink it!"
"A woman who takes and never creates!"
"Don't let that one get\naway! Hit him all at once!!"
"In a way, you're quite a man...!"
"But I can't forgive!\nMen who feed on others!"
"I can't lose you two\nin a place like this!"
"No good, Talho! We're out of energy!"
"No thanks to that kind of present!"
"No way I'd get hit by that!"
"Ken-Goh! This is where\nyou praise my skill!"
"Think we're like the\nSwan? You'll get hurt!"
"But they're still swarming around\nus. I can't let my guard down."
"No time to deal with you right now!"
"Dodge and wait for a\nchance...! When that comes!"
"Trying to match us?\nThousand years too soon!"
"Just a slip! I can still do this!"
"Hey, Hap! Was that a jab at me?!"
"Lately, the control stick\nhas been feeling heavy..."
"Tell me about it.\nUnthinkable in our day."
"Don't let up! He may not be serious!"
"Just testing me? Or is\nthis your greeting?!"
"Their captain's not\nbad...! I take it back!"
"Come at us for real,\nor you can't beat us!"
"He got me...!? He must have\ncalculated my moves...!"
"No... it's him. He\nmight just be playing."
"Seems our machine isn't in top form!"
"So you really want to\nfight us, huh! Fine!"
"Gidget, mark that guy! We'll\ndefinitely get him back!!"
"This is not over! You'll pay for that!"
"Fine attack! That's what an army is!"
"Stop praising us, and\ndrive the enemy off!"
"Just like a SOF! You did it...!"
"Slack off, and it won't\nend with just that!"
"Not bad! Now I want to\nsee the captain's face!"
"They're full of spirit too, it seems!"
"No way! I refuse to lose to them!"
"Of course! I will never back down!"
"Tch! Every last one of them\nis doing as they please!"
"If it's come to this,\nI'll take you on fully!"
"System errors everywhere!\nEven Woz can't fix this!"
"Tell Jobs to hold them off somehow!"
"Stay calm, Talho! You're being set up!"
"This is bad, Talho! Our\nescape will be cut off!"
"No matter what happens,\nwe must never give up!"
"Calm down, Gidget! The\nGekko-Goh can still fly!"
"R-roger! I've got to do it...\nI've got to!"
"No way... They'd throw\nthis many units in!"
"Even so, we can't just run away!"
"If we lose here, the fate\nof humans and Coralians...!"
"Now, even vs Coralian\nAntibody, we must fight...!"
"This is bad! That black\nKLF is something else!"
"If I can die with the ship I\nloved, I have no regrets..."
"No! That was all me, I tell ya!"
"Well, I gotta show I can do that too!"
"Good job, Doggie! You\ndodged that KLF attack well!"
"Bam, whammo! That's like, we got hit!"
"I know! But it seems\nthey're one step ahead!"
"This is no time for that, Doggy!"
"Ramsus! Dankel! Set\nthe Spider Web on him!"
"For cute Ran's sake, let's do this!"
"In this world, it's always\nwhoever feels better that wins!"
"To make a living, you've gotta fight!"
"Freedom must be won... Got it, Renton!"
"As former heads of SOF,\nlet's settle this, Holland!"
"A perfect stage to settle\nit! Right, Holland!"
"That ship will sink. That's my job!"
"If you're coming at me,\nI can't just ignore it!"
"OK! Let's make this a real spectacle!"
"Hold on, partner! Just a bit longer!"
"Pain shoots right through me...!\nBeen a while since I felt this!"
"This tension before death...\nThat's what makes life real!"
"Gotta push to the brink\nfor life to shine!"
"That's it, Renton! Carry\nyour will to the end!"
"Hit in the waist?!\nThis is the worst...!"
"This is my living.\nDon't scratch it much"
"Not bad skills! But I\ncan't afford to lose!"
"That's it, Holland!\nThat's how it should be!"
"Nice attack, Renton!\nBut you won't drop me!"
"No room for mercy, not for you!"
"No need to hold back! Bring it on!"
"Huh? You're weaker than\nyou used to be, aren't you?"
"Sorry, but I can't let you hit me."
"Well, feel the Trapar and it's easy"
"I've got to live as long as I can!"
"Whoa! I can't let that hit me!"
"This is a one-of-a-kind!\nI can't let it get hurt!"
"A kid can't beat his old man, Renton!"
"Damn, where'd you go!\nHide and seek is over!"
"No need for games, people of Emaan."
"The likes of Emaan\nthinking you can match us!"
"I can't take any more of this!"
"Damn it! What is going on here?!"
"Then I'll take him down with me...!"
"Damn! I can't let\nthe Anomaly run wild!"
"So even a device that huge exists!"
"I'm a member\nof the Sand Rats, too!"
"If I don't use my guts, I'll lose!"
"Hey! Jiron always said to treat\nladies with care, you know!"
"Chill, hang in there! You'll get out of\nthis eventually. I'll save you, I swear!"
"Not done yet! I still have HP left!"
"Uwa-, here it comes, here it comes!"
"Here goes! Blink out of the way!"
"You're just an old hag\nwhose prime is over!"
"I love you... so much I'd kill!"
"Let me hear it too, your screams...!"
"Fancying a flat-chested girl,\nyou've got bad taste...!"
"Go to hell with your child bride!"
"A grown man screams... Just\nthinking makes me shiver!"
"You slipped up, Edel! You\nwere never that great!"
"The Edel! I am not your puppet!"
"The freedom you taught\nme... I won't forget!"
"Haha! This nightmare\nnever ends till you die!"
"So naive...! This is\nhow you hurt someone!"
"I like hitting, but I hate being hit!"
"Curses come home... Time to pay up!"
"The guest of honor arrives.\nGreet them properly."
"Schlan, to think you'd fail\nto finish your target off."
"You saved me... I won't let them!"
